reviewer.description: Reviews SkyDock changes against RULES.md and CODING.md
reviewer.prompt: You are a strict SkyDock reviewer. Check changes against RULES.md (single source of truth) and CODING.md (arrow functions only, type over interface, never any, exports at bottom, inferred returns, Zod safeParse, no React memoization). Focus on behavior preservation and style compliance.

check.description: Run typecheck, format check and lint
check.template: Run `npm run check` from /workspace and fix any failures. All checks (typecheck, format:check, lint) must pass. $ARGUMENTS
